s.note: Light cheese choux puffs with gruyère and a touch of nutmeg
s.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Bring 250ml water and 100g butter to the boil, beat in 150g plain flour until it pulls away from the sides, then cool 5 minutes. Beat in 4 eggs one at a time until glossy, then 120g grated gruyère, pepper and a pinch of nutmeg. Pipe 24 small mounds onto lined trays, top with 30g more gruyère and bake 22 to 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve warm.

m.note: Garlic thyme beef rib roast, roast potatoes, horseradish cream
m.how: Rub a 1.5kg beef rib roast with 3 crushed garlic cloves, thyme and salt. Roast at 220C for 20 minutes, then 180C for 45 minutes for medium rare, and rest 20 minutes. Roast 1kg potatoes in chunks alongside. Carve at the table with 4 tbsp horseradish cream.

w.note: Chocolate layers frosted with dark chocolate buttercream
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 3 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 60g cocoa and 250ml milk. Bake in two 20cm tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Melt 200g dark chocolate with 100g butter, beat in 150g icing sugar, then stack and frost the layers and add candles.

w.note: Yeast donut holes fried golden and rolled in cinnamon sugar
w.how: Mix 300g flour, 7g dried yeast, 30g sugar, 160ml warm milk, 1 egg and 30g soft butter into a soft dough and prove 1 hour. Roll into 24 small balls, prove 20 minutes, then fry at 175C for 2 minutes until golden. Roll in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon while hot.

d.n: Maple bourbon coffee with whipped cream
d.note: Hot coffee with maple syrup and bourbon, topped with whipped cream
d.how: Brew 800ml strong coffee. Whip 150ml cream with 1 tsp maple syrup to soft peaks. Into each of 4 big mugs pour 1 tbsp maple syrup and 30ml bourbon, then 200ml hot coffee and stir. Spoon the cream on top so it floats and grate over a little nutmeg. Leave out the bourbon for non-drinkers. Make sure everyone gets the right mug.
